title: Metabolic wave-pinning crawler: polarity protein made from a consumed, regrowing nutrient and degraded, so a cut cell can regrow its size; front cut with twin and a nutrient-off fork
summary: Answering the reviews' point that the repaired crawler stays at 66% of its size because protein is conserved: per-body protein synthesis ksyn*int(phi n) and decay kdeg*N, nutrient n regrowing at rn.
